result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 4, Article 7 (City of San Diego Health Facility Revenue Bond Law), covering city powers and bond issuance provisions; the page URL suggests an anti-algorithmic rent-setting division but that text does not appear in this part.
result.notes: This part contains only health facility revenue bond provisions (""§47.0205"" through ""§47.0402""). Section 47.0206 lets the City fix rents and fees for financing under that bond article, which is not a limit on private residential rents and is not an in-scope rule. The page URL references the algorithmic rent-setting prohibition (§ 98.1103), but no such text appears in this part, so no records are extracted.
